subject: POTENTIAL PROBLEMS FOR USERS OF GPS RECEIVERS.
text:
POTENTIAL PROBLEMS FOR USERS OF GPS RECEIVERS.
1. USERS OF GPS RECEIVERS ARE ADVISED OF POTENTIAL
   PROBLEMS DUE TO GPS WEEK COUNTER ROLL OVER ON
   06 APR 19.
2. THE GPS SYSTEM TRANSMITS TIME TO GPS RECEIVERS
   USING A FORMAT OF TIME AND WEEKS AFTER THE START
   DATE OF 06 JAN 80. THE DATA FIELD IN THE NAVIGATIONAL
   MESSAGE SENT BY GPS SATELLITES CONTAINING THE NUMBER
   OF WEEKS AFTER THE START DATE IS LIMITED TO A MAXIMUM
   OF 1023 WEEKS.  WHEN THE GPS SYSTEM REACHES WEEK 1024,
   THE SYSTEM WILL REVERT BACK TO WEEK ZERO.
3. SOME GPS RECEIVERS ARE KNOWN TO BE UNABLE TO MAKE
   THE TRANSITION FROM WEEK 1023 TO 1024. IF THE GPS
   RECEIVER IS OUTDATED OR LACKS PROPER UPDATES,
   THE RECEIVER WILL REVERT TO READING THE WEEK ZERO
   AS AUGUST 1999. DURING THIS TIME THE INTERNAL CLOCKS OF
   THESE GPS RECEIVERS WILL EXPERIENCE A LACK OF ABSOLUTE
   REFERENCE AND MAY GIVE THE WRONG TIME AND POSITION OR
   MAY LOCK UP PERMANENTLY.
4. SOME OF THESE GPS RECEIVERS ARE REPAIRABLE WITH
   UPGRADES AND OTHERS WILL BECOME UNUSABLE. USERS ARE
   ADVISED TO CHECK WITH THEIR GPS MANUFACTURER REGARDING
   THE STATUS OF THEIR RECEIVER.
5. FOR FURTHER INFORMATION SEE:
   A. GPS WEEK ROLL OVER ISSUE
      www.gps.gov/cgsic/meetings/2017/powers.pdf.
   B. TIMING CRITICALITY AND GPS 1024 WEEK ROLLOVER
      www.gps.gov/governance/advisory/meetings
      SELECT NOVEMBER 2017 AND THEN TIMING CRITICALITY AND
      NOTE ON "GPS WEEK-ROLL-OVER"
   C. GLOBAL POSITIONING SYSTEMS DIRECTORATE,
      SYSTEMS ENGINEERING AND INTEGRATION INTERFACE
      SPECIFICATION IS-GPS-200,
      www.gps.gov/technical/icwg/IS-GPS-200J.pdf.
6. FAILURE TO VERIFY YOUR GPS RECEIVER COULD LEAD
   TO SERIOUS NAVIGATIONAL PROBLEMS PLACING LIVES
   AND PROPERTY AT RISK.

subject: WORLD MAGNETIC MODEL (WMM) 2020 UPDATE AND
text:
WORLD MAGNETIC MODEL (WMM) 2020 UPDATE AND
BLACK OUT ZONE ADVISORY.
1. AS PART OF THE REGULAR UPDATE CYCLE OF THE
   WORLD MAGNETIC MODEL (WMM), THE NATIONAL
   OCEANOGRAPHIC & ATMOSPHERIC ADMINISTRATION
   (NOAA), NATIONAL CENTERS FOR ENVIRONMENTAL
   INFORMATION (NCEI), IN COLLABORATION WITH THE
   BRITISH GEOLOGICAL SURVEY (BGS), WILL RELEASE
   THE 2020 WMM ON 10 DEC. THE CURRENT 2015 WMM
   WILL EXPIRE ON 31 DEC.
2. IN ORDER TO AVOID ANY MODEL PERFORMANCE
   DEGRADATION, USERS ARE RECOMMENDED TO DOWNLOAD
   AND INSTALL THE 2020 MODEL COEFFICIENTS, WHICH
   WILL BE PUBLISHED ONLINE AT
   www.ngdc.noaa.gov/geomag/WMM/soft.shtml.
3. THE UPDATED WMM 2020 MODEL WILL INCLUDE NEW
   BLACK OUT ZONES (BOZ), WHICH WILL IMPACT ALL
   NAVIGATION NEAR THE POLES. COMPASS ACCURACY
   IS INCREASINGLY UNRELIABLE APPROACHING THE BOZ,
   WHERE DECLINATION ERRORS OF UP TO 180 DEGREES
   WILL OCCUR.
4. THE WMM IS THE STANDARD MODEL USED BY THE
   U.S. DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE (DOD), CIVIL AGENCIES,
   THE NORTH ATLANTIC TREATY ORGANIZATION (NATO),
   AND THE INTERNATIONAL HYDROGRAPHIC ORGANIZATION,
   FOR A WIDE-RANGE OF POSITIONING AND NAVIGATION
   SYSTEM APPLICATIONS THAT USE THE GEOMAGNETIC FIELD,
   INCLUDING ALL AIRCRAFT, SHIPS, SUBMARINES AND
   GPS UNITS.
5. FOR FURTHER INFORMATION ON THE BLACK OUT ZONES,
   REFERENCE MIL-PRF-89500B
   www.ngdc.noaa.gov/geomag/WMM/data/MIL-PRF-89500B.pdf.
6. CANCEL THIS MSG 01 JAN 2020.
